label: Personal learning simulation; AI agent executed; independent virtual PDN fixture, not ATE/VNA measurements or geometry-extracted SI/PI
question: At the same VDD_DIE port, how does increasing only die decap from 10 to 30 nF change the impedance spectrum?
hypothesis: Extra C can reduce impedance in some frequency ranges while shifting peaks and not improving every frequency. ESL/ESR and the board network stay fixed; no tuning or target search.
primary_metrics: Maximum sampled magnitude within the predeclared 1..100 MHz band and its sampled frequency
Maximum over the full 0.1..3000 MHz sample band; never equate a boundary maximum with resonance
Magnitude at nearest existing sample to 10, 100 and 1000 MHz; report realized frequencies

numerics.time_basis: Independent steady-state impedance solves; no transient integration
numerics.randomness: PDN branch does not use the validated seed; no random samples or seed ensemble
numerics.convention: exp(+j omega t); impedance in ohm; auxiliary nodal control uses 1 A RMS injection
numerics.boundary: Ideal common ground; ideal VRM source zeroed for driving-point impedance

controls: Independent 2x2 complex nodal solution at all 241 frequencies
KCL residual and passive-resistor power balance with 1 A RMS control source
previous_review: Nov 17 ATE daily experiment varied source rise time in Eye mode; no prior daily PDN-capacitance experiment found. No historical results reused.
